 1VERSE to make Southeast Asia debut in Bangkok in January 2027 as part of 2nd world tour
 SPINS

 Estimated:   reading 
 Words by Hidzir Junaini 
 First published: 11 November 2026 
 Last updated: 11 November 2026

 Gigs

 Events 
 Rising K-pop boy group 1VERSE are heading to Southeast Asia for the first time, with a concert in Bangkok, Thailand, set to kick off their second world tour in January.
 Announced by Korean music label Singing Beetle on 10 November , the show will take place at Mr. Fox Livehouse on 10 January 2027 , marking the five-member group's first-ever performance in the region.
 The upcoming concert also represents a significant milestone for 1VERSE, as it will be the first time all five members travel overseas together, including HYUK and SEOK , the group's two North Korean-born members.
 Following their first world tour across North America and Europe, the group are preparing to expand their international presence with a second tour spanning more continents, beginning in Thailand.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by 1VERSE Official (@official1verse) 
 For member NATHAN , the Bangkok stop holds particular personal significance, given his family ties to the country.
 "Thailand has always been on my bucket list since my dad's side of the family is from Thailand," he shared. "It's a huge honor, I'm so excited to get to perform there and also experience culture I'm familiar with!"
 Since making their debut in July 2025 , 1VERSE have attracted international attention for their unique backgrounds and musical journey. Their story has been covered by major global news outlets including BBC , CNN , Reuters , and Associated Press , with media coverage spanning more than 40 countries.
 Despite their growing international profile and previous performances in North America and Europe, the group have yet to tour Asia, making their upcoming Bangkok concert a particularly meaningful homecoming to the region.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by 1VERSE Official (@official1verse) 
 Beyond their live performances, 1VERSE have also been developing their creative identities as musicians. The members have contributed to the writing and composition of their recent releases, while their forthcoming first mini-album is set to feature songs they have produced themselves.
 With their second world tour on the horizon, the Bangkok show marks a new chapter for 1VERSE as they continue bringing their music and story to audiences around the world.
 Tickets for 1VERSE's Bangkok concert will go on sale on 20 November at 5 PM ICT (7 PM KST) through the group's official channels. Further details about the show and upcoming tour will be announced via 1VERSE's social media platforms.
